s: Resource naming, CRUD, pagination, versioning, HATEOAS
d: REST is the dominant API style. It's stateless, resource-oriented, and uses HTTP verbs. Knowing how to design clean, consistent RESTful APIs is a core skill you'll use in every backend project.

p: Representational State Transfer (REST) is an architectural style for APIs. It utilizes standard HTTP methods and treats everything as a 'Resource' accessed via a distinct URI.
2. Use standard verbs: GET (Read), POST (Create), PUT/PATCH (Update), DELETE (Destroy).

// Express.js REST Route
app.patch('/api/users/:id', async (req, res) => {
  const updatedUser = await User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.params.id, req.body);
  if (!updatedUser) return res.status(404).send('Not found');
  res.status(200).json(updatedUser);
});

Resource: /articles
GET /articles          -> Get list of articles
POST /articles         -> Create a new article
GET /articles/123      -> Get article 123
DELETE /articles/123   -> Delete article 123
